verdict.rationale: Composio publishes an OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key) and documents programmatic control through its SDK: creating sessions, configuring toolkits, and creating MCP servers via composio.mcp.create. It also documents registering a signed webhook destination for trigger events. Missing for 10: quoted REST endpoint reference content beyond the spec's existence (auth scheme, endpoint listings), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the platform through the raw API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.composio.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
You register it once per project, and Composio `POST`s every trigger event there, signed so you can verify it.
